blocks.title: Safety reading
blocks.content:
Under the Wound Dressing profile, this construct clears every assessed gate.
Toxicity (ToxinPred3) reports 0.17 against a threshold of 0.38 from a platform-wide constant, which is at or below the limit.
Haemolysis (HemoPI2) reports 0.415827 against a threshold of 0.55 from the predictor's own cut-off, which is at or below the limit.
Immunogenicity (MHC-I) has no predictor value (screening threshold 0.35), so it is reported as not assessed rather than as a pass. The pipeline's rule is that an unassessed metric does not eliminate a candidate.
Soft signals, which do not veto: B-cell epitope (soft) 0.254114 (threshold 0.1512); Immunogenicity (MHC-II %) 2.36 (threshold 2).
